parsed.detail: You put in a really heavy week on the road, adding 120 minutes compared to last week across your 4 sessions. That is a lot of good, dedicated work. Most of that time was spent at a moderate effort rather than easy, and your fatigue has climbed well above your fitness. The body gets stronger while it recovers, not during the session itself. After such a demanding week, backing off gives your muscles and nervous system time to adapt. For the coming days, swapping some of those steady efforts for very gentle spins, or simply taking some downtime, will help all that training truly take hold.
parsed.line: You put in a really heavy week of training, and that dedication deserves credit. The body gets stronger during recovery, so taking extra rest or swapping moderate efforts for gentle outings will let that work sink in.

options.label: Take quiet rest
options.description: Give your body time off so your fatigue can fade.

options.label: Swap to easy
options.description: Replace your moderate efforts with very gentle, relaxed movement.
